info.title: Masky Developer API
info.description: Full Masky HTTP API: images, avatars, conversations, talking-head video, and Login with Masky (OAuth 2.0 SSO). Human docs at https://masky.ai/api/docs

bearerAuth.description: Either a Masky API key (mky_...) or a Firebase ID token.

post.summary: Create a new API key
post.description: Returns the raw mky_ token ONCE. Store it; the server keeps only a hash.

get.summary: List the caller's API keys (no raw tokens)

owner.description: The caller's account, for building masky.ai/{slug} links (slug = username || twitchUsername || userId). Present even when the account has no avatars.

post.summary: Create a new avatar
post.description: imageUrl, if supplied, is fetched and re-hosted on Masky's storage. Without a voiceId the avatar is text-only; upload voice samples via masky.ai to enable audio/video.

get.summary: List publicly renderable avatars across all users
get.description: No auth required. Returned avatars can be rendered by any caller; the owner pays the generation credits.

get.summary: Look up a user's renderable avatars by uid, handle, or Twitch username
get.description: Requires any valid bearer token. Resolves the identifier like public pages do (uid -> Masky handle -> Twitch username, case-insensitive) and returns the user's self-avatar, avatars marked publiclyRenderable, and their chosen stream-identity avatar (even when private - choosing it is consent), with the owner block and a top-level streamIdentity {avatarId, imageUrl|null} when one is set. The stream-identity avatar carries isStreamDefault: true (plus streamImageUrl when a specific still was chosen); overlays should prefer it, pass streamImageUrl as avatarImageUrl on speak, and retry without the image override on a 400 (stale still). Built for read-the-viewer's-own-message flows: pass the returned avatarOwnerUserId + avatarId to POST /avatars/{avatarId}/speak (charged to the caller). An avatar is voice-capable when voiceId is non-null. An unknown identifier returns 200 {"found": false}.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: uid, Masky handle, or Twitch username

200.description: {found, owner?, streamIdentity?, avatars?} - avatars use the same shape as GET /avatars, plus isDefaultAvatar and isStreamDefault

get.summary: Get the caller's stream identity (avatar + still used when overlays read their messages)
get.description: Returns {streamIdentity: null} until one is set or when the chosen avatar was deleted; otherwise {streamIdentity: {avatarId, imageUrl|null, displayName, voiceId, updatedAt}}. voiceId null means the choice cannot speak yet and overlays will fall back. OAuth tokens need the 'avatars:read' or 'generate' scope.

put.summary: Set or clear the caller's stream identity
put.description: Body {avatarId, imageUrl?}. The avatar must be the caller's own; imageUrl, when given, must be one of that avatar's stills (GET /avatars/{avatarId}/images lists valid values) - otherwise 400. avatarId null/empty clears the setting. Note: choosing a private avatar exposes it via GET /avatars/lookup - that is the feature. When the caller has a connected Twitch login, the choice is also mirrored to the world-readable Firestore doc streamIdentities/{twitchLogin} ({userId, avatarId, imageUrl|null, avatarImageUrl, displayName, ownerDisplayName, voiceId, updatedAt}) so overlays can render chat identities with one unauthenticated Firestore read; clearing (or re-setting after a Twitch rename) removes the stale mirror doc. OAuth tokens need the 'generate' scope.

avatarId.description: One of the caller's avatar ids; null/empty clears

imageUrl.description: Optional still from GET /avatars/{avatarId}/images; omitted means the avatar's primary image at render time

400.description: imageUrl not one of the avatar's images

404.description: avatarId is not one of the caller's avatars

post.summary: Toggle publiclyRenderable on an avatar you own

get.summary: List voices available to the caller
get.description: Curated preset voices plus any custom voices already attached to avatars the caller owns. Use the returned id with /avatars/{id}/voice or pass it as voiceId on create_avatar.

post.summary: Build a Masky Gem for the avatar (personality + knowledge base)
post.description: Forwards the avatar's personalityPrompt + knowledgeBaseUrls to the Masky Gems microservice. Persists the returned gemRef on the avatar so future chat/turn calls reuse it instead of re-fetching URLs each turn. Gemini's app-product 'Gems' has no public API; this is our equivalent.

post.summary: Attach a voice to an avatar you own
Start a new conversation with an avatar
post.description: Returns conversationId, the shareUrl (interactive page), and a liveUrl with embedded viewerToken for OBS / web embeds.

403.description: Avatar not yours and not publiclyRenderable

post.summary: Inject a user turn into a conversation
post.description: Asynchronous — returns a pending Turn id; subscribe to /liveTurns/{viewerToken}/turns or poll to watch status flip to audio then video.

mode.description: chat = Gemini answers using personality + history. speak = userText is spoken by the avatar (skips Gemini).

reinterpret.description: Only used when mode=speak. true rewrites userText via Gemini in the avatar's voice before TTS.

post.summary: Toggle conversation public/private

get.summary: Fetch conversation metadata and full turn list
get.description: Public conversations are readable without auth. Private conversations require the owner's bearer token.

403.description: Private and viewer is not the owner

post.summary: One-shot avatar TTS / talking-head video
post.description: Use this when you need a single audio or video clip without a chat thread.

avatarImageUrl.description: Optional still to render with — must be a url from GET /avatars/{avatarId}/images (400 otherwise). Default: the avatar's primary image.

language.description: Optional BCP-47-ish code (e.g. "es", "pt-br") declaring the language of `text`. The voice speaks whatever language the text is in — send text already in the target language; with textMode=personality the rewrite is produced in this language.

get.summary: Get one-shot generation status + signed URLs

post.summary: Generate an image from text. Sync. Needs 'generate' scope for SSO tokens.

model.description: 'ideogram' renders legible in-image text/typography at 3x the credit cost; 'default' garbles text. If omitted, prompts containing double-quoted text auto-route to 'ideogram' so the quoted words appear verbatim, and unquoted prompts that clearly intend readable words are detected by a reasoning pass and routed the same way; pass a model explicitly to pin it.

post.summary: Edit/compose from 1-5 reference images. Needs 'generate' scope for SSO tokens.

model.description: default (0.01 credits) or qwen (0.03 credits, renders legible in-image text; max 2 reference images). Omitted: prompts with "double-quoted" text auto-route to qwen when 1-2 references are given, and unquoted prompts that clearly intend readable words are detected and routed the same way.

post.summary: Register a Login-with-Masky client. First-party mky_ key only.

serviceAvatarId.description: Optional: one of your avatar ids. Enables grant_type=client_credentials — the app acts as this avatar.

200.description: { clientId, clientSecret (shown once), name, redirectDomains, scopes }

patch.summary: Set or clear the client's service avatar (owner only). Enables grant_type=client_credentials: the app acts as this avatar. Send {"serviceAvatarId": "<avatarId>"} or {"serviceAvatarId": null}.

serviceAvatarId.description: One of the owner's avatar ids, or null to disable client_credentials.

400.description: serviceAvatarId must be one of your avatars

post.summary: Exchange an authorization code for a scoped mky_ access token, or use grant_type=client_credentials to act as the client's service avatar (no user, no consent). No auth (client_secret or PKCE in body).

scope.description: client_credentials only: space-separated scopes to request (subset of the client's scopes; defaults to all).

schema.description: authorization_code requires code + redirect_uri (+ client_secret or code_verifier). client_credentials requires client_secret and a serviceAvatarId configured on the client; the token acts AS that avatar and bills the client owner. Tokens are long-lived — request once and store.

get.summary: Avatar identity for an SSO access token.
List apps a user has authorized (connected apps). First-party key.

delete.summary: Revoke one issued SSO access token.

post.summary: Generate a video from a prompt — text-to-video, or image-to-video from any public image or one of your avatars' stills — with generated sound, a line in your avatar's voice, or your own audio. Not lip-synced (use a speak turn for talking to camera). Async: returns 202, then poll GET /videos/{generationId}. Every render gets a /v-yy-mm-xxxx share page. Billed per second of the finished video, once, on success (rates: GET /videos/pricing). Needs 'generate' scope for SSO tokens.

prompt.description: The video to generate — and, without speechText/audio, what it sounds like (effects, ambience, music)

avatarId.description: One of your avatars (404 otherwise). With image omitted the clip opens on its primary still. Required for speechText

image.description: Opening frame: any public http(s) jpg/png/webp URL. Omit to use the avatar's still when avatarId is set; null forces pure text-to-video

lastFrameImage.description: Closing frame: any public http(s) image URL

speechText.description: Spoken in the avatar's voice (needs avatarId with a voice) and used as the audio input; its length sets the clip length. Not lip-synced. Mutually exclusive with audio

audio.description: Public flac/mp3/wav URL used as the audio input; its length sets the clip length. Mutually exclusive with speechText

duration.description: Seconds. Omit to let the model choose. Ignored when speechText or audio is set

aspectRatio.description: Ignored when an image is used

promptUpsampling.description: Let the model expand the prompt; false uses it verbatim

202.description: { generationId, slug, url, status:'queued', seconds, creditCost, firestorePath, poll } — seconds/creditCost are a quote (20s upper bound when the model picks the length)

400.description: Invalid or missing field, speechText without a voiced avatarId, speechText together with audio, or a field from the retired video API

get.summary: Poll a video job: status queued|rendering|ready|error. videoUrl is set once ready, and seconds/creditCost become the billed values. Finalizes a finished render if the background job died.

200.description: { generationId, slug, url, status, videoUrl, seconds, creditCost, error? }

get.summary: Tribe info + whether the caller is a member. Needs 'tribes' scope for SSO tokens.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Masky uid or twitchUsername of the tribe owner

200.description: { user, tribeName, joinCost, memberCount, isMember, isOwner }

get.summary: Is ?member= in {user}'s tribe? Caller must be the tribe owner or the member (defaults to caller). Needs 'tribes' scope for SSO tokens.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Masky uid or twitchUsername of the tribe owner

parameters.name: member
parameters.description: uid or twitchUsername; defaults to the caller

403.description: Caller is neither the tribe owner nor the queried member, or token lacks 'tribes' scope

post.summary: Join {user}'s tribe, paying their tribeJoinCost in the caller's credits (free for the creator's active Twitch subscribers). Needs 'tribes' scope for SSO tokens.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Masky uid or twitchUsername of the tribe owner

400.description: Already a member / own tribe / { error: 'Insufficient balance', balance, required }

post.summary: Propose a user-to-user credit gift. Moves nothing: the user must confirm at the returned confirmUrl (masky.ai) with their first-party session. Intents expire after 10 minutes. Needs 'donations' scope for SSO tokens.

200.description: { intentId, status:'pending', amount, to, from, note, createdAt, expiresAt, confirmUrl }

400.description: Bad amount / self-gift / { error: 'Insufficient transferable credits', transferable, required }

get.summary: Gift intent status (poll after opening confirmUrl). Caller must be the sender; SSO tokens must be from the proposing app.

post.summary: EXECUTE the gift. First-party Firebase session only — OAuth/mky_ tokens are always rejected; called by masky.ai's donate-confirm page, not by apps.

403.description: Delegated token, or not the sender

post.summary: Cancel a pending gift intent (sender or proposing app).

get.summary: Confirmed credit gifts the caller has sent to ?to= (totals + history). Needs 'donations' scope for SSO tokens.

200.description: { to, total, count, gifts: [{ amount, note, createdAt }] }

get.summary: List the avatar's still-image variants (primary + assets). Any returned url is a valid avatarImageUrl for /avatars/{avatarId}/speak or /conversations/{conversationId}/avatar-image. Own avatars always; others only when publiclyRenderable. SSO tokens need 'avatars:read' or 'generate'.

parameters.name: avatarOwnerUserId
parameters.description: Owner uid when listing someone else's publicly renderable avatar; defaults to the caller

200.description: { avatarId, avatarOwnerUserId, primary, images: [{ url, assetId, isPrimary, createdAt }] }

403.description: Avatar not publicly renderable / token lacks 'avatars:read' or 'generate' scope

post.summary: Add a still-image variant to one of your avatars (owner only). Masky fetches imageUrl, stores it, and records it as an asset; the primary image is unchanged. The returned url is valid as imageUrl on /videos/video-2 and avatarImageUrl on /avatars/{avatarId}/speak. SSO tokens need 'generate'.

imageUrl.description: Public http(s) URL of an image (image/* content-type, max 12MB)

200.description: { avatarId, assetId, url } - url is the stored Firebase Storage URL

400.description: imageUrl missing / not http(s) / could not be fetched as an image (max 12MB)

404.description: Avatar not found (you must be the owner)

post.summary: Switch the still image the conversation renders video turns with (owner only). Must be a url from GET /avatars/{avatarId}/images for the conversation's avatar.

400.description: avatarImageUrl missing or not an asset of this avatar

get.summary: Per-second credit rates for POST /videos/generate by resolution and draft mode, plus valid resolutions, aspect ratios and fps (no auth).

200.description: { endpoint, currency, billing, perSecond, audioPerSecond, defaultResolution, minSeconds, maxSeconds, defaultSeconds, charsPerSpokenSecond, resolutions, aspectRatios, fps }

post.summary: Local-agent bridge: deliver the reply text for a turn awaiting an external agent
post.description: Completes a turn the worker parked in status awaiting_agent because the avatar has an agentBinding (a nostr pubkey + relay on the avatar doc). Auth is NIP-98 style: an Authorization: Nostr <base64 kind-27235 event> header signed by the BOUND nostr key, with tags ['u', full URL], ['method','POST'], ['payload', sha256 hex of the raw body]. No Masky bearer token is used - the pubkey is the identity. TTS/video render then proceeds as a normal turn.

text.description: The avatar reply text the local agent produced

200.description: Reply accepted; the render pipeline resumes

401.description: Missing/invalid Nostr auth event (signature, url, method, payload hash, or created_at window)

403.description: Signer is not the pubkey bound to this turn

409.description: Turn is not awaiting an agent (already completed, rendered, or errored)

410.description: Turn request expired; the worker has moved on to the fallback

post.summary: Local-agent bridge: publish a test ping through the avatar's agentBinding relay
post.description: Owner-only. Publishes a signed masky_binding_ping nostr event through the exact turn-request path (same signing key, same relay AUTH handling) so the binding can be verified before a real turn depends on it. Body may carry {binding: {...}} to test unsaved values; otherwise the avatar doc's saved agentBinding is used (a parked enabled:false binding is still testable). Returns the bridge's sender pubkey so the harness can pin it.

binding.description: Binding to test instead of the saved one

pubkey.description: 64-char hex nostr pubkey of the agent

extraTags.description: Extra nostr tags for the event and the NIP-42 AUTH handshake

200.description: Relay accepted the ping: { ok, eventId, serverPubkey, relay, kind }

403.description: Caller is not the avatar owner

502.description: Relay rejected or timed out: { ok:false, error, serverPubkey }
